project.name: student-test-local-recommendations
project.description: Local rule-based recommendation labels for the redesigned CEFR vocabulary test flow.

meaning_rebuild.title: Rebuild Meaning Accuracy
meaning_rebuild.summaryTemplate: Your {selectedLevel} result shows that {weakestSkill} is the clearest area to rebuild first.
meaning_rebuild.rationaleTemplate: {strongestSkill} is currently steadier, so the next study block should focus on more precise {weakestSkill} work before the next {selectedLevel} test.
techniques: Review missed items in small synonym groups.
Write one short sentence for every corrected answer.

collocation_builder.title: Build Stronger Collocations
collocation_builder.summaryTemplate: Your {selectedLevel} result suggests that {weakestSkill} patterns need the most attention next.
collocation_builder.rationaleTemplate: Because {strongestSkill} is more stable than {weakestSkill}, phrase-level practice should produce the fastest improvement before the next test.
books: Oxford Collocations Dictionary for Students of English
courses: British Council speaking and vocabulary practice
techniques: Collect errors as two-word and three-word chunks.
Repeat common verb-noun pairs aloud until they sound natural.

wordform_control.title: Tighten Wordform Control
wordform_control.summaryTemplate: Your {selectedLevel} test shows that {weakestSkill} control is the main skill gap right now.
wordform_control.rationaleTemplate: Since {strongestSkill} is already more reliable, the best next gain comes from practicing how {weakestSkill} changes inside full sentences.
techniques: Build word-family tables for missed answers.
Decide part of speech before choosing the final option.

mixed_review_builder.title: Stabilize Mixed Performance
mixed_review_builder.summaryTemplate: Your {selectedLevel} result is reasonably balanced, so the best next step is a mixed review across all three test categories.
mixed_review_builder.rationaleTemplate: Because {strongestSkill} and {weakestSkill} are closer together, a mixed timed review should strengthen overall control before the next session.
techniques: Rotate between meaning, collocation, and wordform in one sitting.
Finish each review block with a short timed mixed set.
